blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Jema Galanza and Bernadeth Pons drilled the telling blows to lead Creamline past Capital1, 25-18, 31-29, 25-16, for a 4-0 record in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Thursday night at Santiago Sports Arena in Isabela. Galanza continued to lead the Cool Smashers’ balanced attack with 16 points and 11 excellent receptions, highlighted by her clutch showing in the extended second set to avoid a meltdown, while Pons slammed the door on Capital1 with her big hits in the third to finish with 11 points and eight digs off the bench. “That part of the game […]...
